CA.rationale: C present for candidate content; attention/processing evidence (command_estimate) links to same content but intent/attention relation is not fully explicit, so ambiguous.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) and an organization/origin label (completed_record) plus separate status labeling are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing/command_estimate language links to the content's representation but does not clearly assert an attention/allocation relation, making the attention relation ambiguous.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (colour-labelled sets with coordinates) are present.

D.rationale: The report separately labels content instances and attaches distinct origin/status descriptors (completed_record, history_estimate), explicitly differentiating identity from status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization descriptors and candidate/current presentation labels describe how contents are represented or presented.
